items.title: Railway raises $100M to challenge AWS with AI-native cloud
items.summary: Railway secured $100M to build AI-native cloud infrastructure, attracting 2M developers without marketing.
items.so_what: This well-funded startup directly challenges hyperscalers by offering specialized, potentially more efficient AI compute.

items.title: Salesforce's new Slackbot AI agent battles Microsoft & Google
items.summary: Salesforce rebuilt Slackbot into a full AI agent for enterprise data search, drafting, and action, now generally available.
items.so_what: A major enterprise player intensifies competition in workplace AI, raising the bar for integrated AI agent capabilities.

items.title: Anthropic launches Cowork: Claude Desktop agent for non-coders
items.summary: Anthropic's Cowork extends Claude Code's power to non-technical users, allowing file interaction without coding.
items.so_what: This broadens AI agent adoption beyond developers, significantly expanding the market for mainstream AI applications.

items.title: Railway raises $100M for AI-native cloud, challenging AWS
items.summary: Railway secured $100M to build AI-native cloud infrastructure, aiming to disrupt hyperscalers like AWS with optimized compute.
items.so_what: This funding signals a serious challenge to incumbent cloud providers, potentially reshaping compute pricing and availability for AI workloads.

items.title: Salesforce launches new Slackbot AI agent, escalating workplace AI battle
items.summary: Salesforce rebuilt Slackbot into a full AI agent, capable of searching enterprise data, drafting documents, and taking action.
items.so_what: This significantly escalates the battle for enterprise workplace AI, directly challenging Microsoft and Google's offerings.

items.title: Anthropic's Cowork: Claude Desktop agent for non-coders
items.summary: Anthropic released Cowork, a desktop AI agent extending Claude's power to non-technical users for file interaction without coding.
items.so_what: This broadens the market for AI agents significantly, making advanced capabilities accessible beyond developers and intensifying the agent race.
